subject: Mathematics

source.topic: Numbers, operations and relationships: Counting (integrated with number patterns and mental maths)
source.subtopic: Count forwards and backwards in 1s from any number to 60 (weeks 1-2), 80 (weeks 3-6) and 100 (weeks 7-10)

show.line: Let's count on from any number. Twenty-seven, twenty-eight, twenty-nine, thirty! Now backwards. Thirty, twenty-nine, twenty-eight.

rounds.prompt: Count on with me. Thirty-six, thirty-seven, thirty-eight. What comes next?
Look at this number. Say it.
Count backwards. Fifty-two, fifty-one, fifty. What comes next?
rounds.praise: Forty-nine! Going backwards, the number gets smaller.

rounds.prompt: Which number comes just after fifty-nine?
Count on. Seventeen, eighteen, nineteen. What comes next?
Which number comes just before thirty?

hints: Counting forwards, the number gets one bigger each time.
Say the numbers slowly. Listen to the number before.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will count on from forty-seven.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! After forty-nine comes fifty, not sixty.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's count together. Forty-seven, forty-eight, forty-nine, fifty!

parent_line: Can count forwards and backwards in ones from any number up to 60.
